langer.method: nu_L = (lambda_+/2pi) sqrt(det H_min/|det H_sad|), lambda_+ the positive root of det(lambda^2 m I + lambda diag(m/tau_i) + H_sad) = 0; Hessians by central finite differences of the BAR rest-state U at the relaxed minimum and the accepted gate saddle; compared with nu_hat of E4_analysis (attempt rate with slope held at -dU); ratio CI = bootstrap of the median over (snapshot, condition) fits

participation.method: unstable eigenvector of H_sad (full condition), agent weights p_i = |e_i|^2, PR = 1/sum p_i^2; also the dynamic unstable mode of the Langer matrix and the minimum-to-saddle displacement; 'fitted' = snapshots with a full Arrhenius fit

shifted_exponential.method: hazard 0 before a lag t0 shared by all groups, then constant with one rate per group; the likelihood rises with t0 up to the earliest observed escape, so the MLE sits on that boundary; interval = t0 with log-likelihood within 1.92 of the maximum

all.method: pooled Weibull shape (one shape, a scale per (snapshot, condition, level) group) of the runs still trapped at t0, times measured from t0, on a 0.25 s grid of t0; 95% profile-likelihood intervals; first_cover = smallest t0 whose interval contains 1, cover_from = smallest t0 from which every larger grid t0 contains 1 (up to 15 s)

published_collapse.method: WLS of ln(lambda / nu_hat) on dU/kT (the paper's collapse), nu_hat fitted per (snapshot, condition) with the slope held at -1, so the intercept is near 0 by construction; snapshot bootstrap

common_intercept.method: WLS of ln lambda on dU/kT with one slope and one intercept for all points (no per-snapshot attempt rate), weights = events; snapshot bootstrap

free_intercepts.method: WLS of ln lambda on dU/kT with one slope and a free intercept per (snapshot, condition), weights = events; snapshot bootstrap

e3_ols.method: E3_analysis.json ell.per_step.slope_ols (OLS of observed on predicted ell, bootstrap over snapshots)

competing_exits.rule: escape = blocker centre at x >= 10 (or the blocker leaves the simulation); another agent leaving first neither stops nor censors the run, it is only flagged (experiments/lib/runlib.py escape)

selection.method: selection.json: BAR.gate_excluded, BAR.n, E3.n / n_qualifying, E4.n / n_qualifying

saddle_ratio.method: dU_full / dU_alone per E4 snapshot; 'fitted' = snapshots with a full-condition Arrhenius fit (seed60 and seed170 have none)

pair.method: E7b_analysis.json d_barriers; count of snapshots with dU/kT < 1 at every sigma level

lone.method: E6_analysis.json lifetimes.barrier_picture (56 accepted library barriers, all mobile)
